about_the_game:
The world is dark and empty.

A Dark Forest Demo is an incremental idle horror game about discovering the unknown within and without yourself. This is a temporary demo version while we prepare for the final update!

Everything the darkness touches is yours.

Explore the world, gather resources and carve out a community of your own inside the dark forest.

Remember… the Darkness never sleeps, and it doesn't like new challengers.

Savior or tyrant?

Ward off 11 abyssal entities. Will you spare or execute them?

There will be consequences… in the full version.

My good steward!

Control the faceless masses. Experience a strategic resource production chain mechanic and choose how you reign!

Will you implement absolute rule, allow for limited autonomy and freewill, or establish secretive freemasonry?

Dear diary…

Experience a twisting narrative. Will you shape the world, or be shaped by it?

Will you ever stop, or is your greed immeasurable?
